title: Pessimistic Offline Lock Failure
pattern: Acquiring an offline, database-backed lock across business transactions (which can span minutes or hours) without implementing an automatic expiration timeout.
why_bad: If a user's session is abruptly terminated, the offline lock remains active in the database permanently. This blocks all other users from modifying that resource, bringing business workflows to a halt.
detection: Offline lock tables or lock managers that lack creation timestamps, expiration parameters, or background cleanup routines.
counterexample: Implementing offline locks with a strict TTL (time-to-live) expiration.
fix:
Enforce a TTL timeout on all offline locks.
```rust
lock_manager.acquire_offline_lock("order_123", Duration::from_mins(30));
```
